author: Zoe Tillman, Erik Larson
description: A US trade court has revived a challenge to President Donald Trump’s move to end a tariff exemption for low-dollar imports, resuming a legal fight with financial stakes for online retailers and small businesses as well as Americans who directly buy goods overseas.
title: Legal Fight Reopens Over Trump’s Push to Tax Low-Value Imports

author: Steven T. Dennis
description: The Republican Senate Agriculture Committee chair called for new federal aid to farmers in the wake of a spike in gasoline, diesel and fertilizer prices driven by the US military offensive against Iran.
title: Senate Agriculture Chair Urges Farm Rescue After Oil Price Surge

description: Workers who powered a tariff-defying boom tell a grim story of falling wages and vanishing jobs.
title: Xi’s Export Juggernaut Is Leaving China’s Factory Workers Behind

author: Swati Pandey
description: Australia will send a surveillance aircraft to the Middle East and supply the United Arab Emirates with advanced air-to-air missiles to defend against Iranian attacks and keep local airspace open in order to help stranded Australians return home.
title: Australia Will Send Spy Jet, Missiles to Help UAE Fend Off Iran

description: CSIS Middle East Program Director and Senior Adviser Mona Yacoubian says President Trump’s comments that the war is “very complete” suggest an effort to create an economic off-ramp amid concerns a surge in oil prices could disrupt the U.S. economy. She warns any attempted exit would be far more complicated, saying the conflict has opened Pandora’s Box in the region and will be difficult to de-escalate. Yacoubian adds differences between U.S. and Israeli objectives risk further instability. She speaks on the late edition of Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Yacoubian Says Trump May Be Signaling Iran Offramp

description: President Donald Trump says certain oil-related sanctions will be taken off to reduce prices during a news conference in Florida. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Waiving Certain Oil-Related Sanctions

author: Jimmy Jenkins
description: The president of the Arizona State Senate said he had provided records to the Federal Bureau of Investigation related to a review by Republican lawmakers into the 2020 presidential election.
title: Arizona Lawmaker Turns Over 2020 Election Data to Trump’s FBI

author: Sherif Tarek
description: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun called for internationally mediated direct negotiations with Israel and a truce that would halt Israeli attacks on his country and extricate it from yet another Middle East conflict.
title: Lebanon Seeks Direct Talks With Israel to End Hezbollah Fighting

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Norah Mulinda speak with Bloomberg Economics Chief Geoeconomics Analyst Jennifer Welch as global markets keep an eye on oil amid the Iran war. Then, Bloomberg News Senior National Economic Correspondent Nancy Cook on her Big Take story about President Trump digging in on the Iran war, dividing MAGA loyalists. Plus, Needham's Laura Martin as Netlif goes from an M&A loser to likely market winner without the WBD deal. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Stocks, Commodities Waver as Iran Conflict Continues | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 3/9/2026

description: Former US Ambassador to NATO Julianne Smith says continued ballistic missile attacks on Turkey could trigger NATO consultations and a potential response. Ambassador Smith also says the pace of US munitions use is straining weapons supplies for Ukraine, and Russia and China stand to benefit as Washington becomes increasingly distracted. She speaks on the late edition of Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Fmr. Ambassador to NATO Warns Iran Conflict Could Test Commitments

description: “It’s going to be finished pretty quickly,” President Donald Trump says during an event in Florida referencing the war in Iran. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says Iran War Will Be 'Finished Pretty Quickly'

author: David Voreacos
description: A US judge ruled Monday that the Trump administration illegally appointed a trio of lawyers to succeed Alina Habba after her resignation as the top federal prosecutor in New Jersey.
title: Trump’s Trio of NJ Successors to Habba Ruled Illegally Appointed

author: Steven T. Dennis, Matt Shirley
description: President Donald Trump’s efforts to force Republicans to pass a partisan overhaul of voting laws risks bringing congressional business to a halt with no clear path to success, Senate Majority Leader John Thune warned Monday.
title: GOP Leader Warns Trump on Muscling Senate Over Voting Bill

author: Ari Natter, Jennifer A Dlouhy, Josh Wingrove
description: President Donald Trump is mulling a menu of possible options to combat surging oil and gasoline prices in the wake of the Iran war, according to people familiar with the matter.
title: Trump Weighs Several Options to Tame Surging Gasoline Prices

author: Nathan R Dean
description: Trump weighs his next steps in the conflict as oil prices surge.
title: Some Outstanding Questions About the War With Iran

author: Jorge Valero, Alberto Nardelli
description: The US told its Group of Seven partners that Russia sanctions relief would be temporary as it reacts to spiking energy prices amid the war in Iran, the European Union’s economy chief said.
title: US Told G-7 That Russian Sanctions Waivers Would be Limited

author: Oscar Medina
description: A 48-year-old senator calling for a military offensive against cocaine cartels has a strong shot at becoming Colombia’s first female president.
title: Security Hardliner Could Become Colombia’s First Woman President

author: Alaric Nightingale
description: Russian President Vladimir Putin and his US counterpart Donald Trump discussed Iran in their first phone talk this year.
title: Putin and Trump Discuss Iran in First Phone Call This Year

author: Jorge Valero, Alessandra Migliaccio, Kamil Kowalcze
description: The current situation in energy markets — triggered by the war in Iran — would allow for the release of strategic oil reserves, according to European Union Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis.
title: EU’s Dombrovskis Says Release of Oil Reserves Would Be Warranted

description: CIBC Private Wealth Managing Director Rebecca Babin says oil prices could spike again if there's no timeline about when the war with Iran could end. She says "panic could resume." Oil pared back below $100 after reaching almost $120 on Monday. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Oil Could Spike Again, Babin Says

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the spike in oil prices as war in Iran continues. On today's show, former Democratic Congresswoman Jane Harman, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino, Bluestack Strategies Founder Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and CIBC Private Wealth Managing Director Rebecca BabinMSG BLOWBRK. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: War Triggers Tumult in Oil Market | Balance of Power: Early Edition 3/09/2026

author: Eric Laperozy
description: Madagascar’s military ruler Michael Randrianirina has dissolved the government and will appoint a new prime minister in the coming days in accordance with the country’s laws, the presidency said in a statement Monday.
title: Madagascar Leader Dissolves Government, New Premier to Be Named

author: Steven T. Dennis
description: Just a couple of weeks ago, President Donald Trump was touting lower gas prices during his State of the Union. Now, after his war on Iran drove oil prices above $100 a barrel, Democrats are turning the tables.
title: Democrats Seize on Iran-Driven Gas Prices in Appeals to Voters

description:
An energy price shock caused by the Iran war has led to jitters in global bond markets and a rethink on the outlook for interest rates.

Alice Atkins explains why inflation is worrying traders. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran War Sparks Bond Market Jitters and Rethink on Rates

author: Kate Sullivan
description: US President Donald Trump confronted mounting pressures on the 10th day of the Iran war as oil prices surged past $100 and the Islamic Republic announced the hardline son of the assassinated Ayatollah Ali Khamenei as its new supreme leader.
title: Trump Insists ‘I Have a Plan’ as Oil Prices Surge on Iran War

description: Group of Seven finance ministers said they were ready to take any steps needed to support global energy supply, including releasing strategic oil reserves — but the group is not ready to do that yet. Tyler Kendall repots.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: G-7 Ready to Help Stabilize Energy Prices

author: Stacey Vanek Smith
description: Cheap fuel had been a bright spot for the US economy before tankers stopped moving through the Middle East.
title: Gas Prices Are Rising—and So Are the Iran War Stakes for Trump

author: Alessandra Migliaccio
description: Italian Finance Minister Giancarlo Giorgetti cautioned against the temptation to hike interest rates in response to fallout from the conflict in the Middle East.
title: Italy’s Giorgetti Cautions Against Temptation to Raise ECB Rates

description: Anthropic PBC is suing the Defense Department after it said the company is a supply chain risk. Anthropic and the Pentagon have been in a dispute over safeguards on its AI technology. Seth Fiegerman reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Anthropic Sues US for Being Labeled Supply Chain Risk

author: Gonzalo Soto, Alex Vasquez
description: The US-Mexico-Canada free trade deal shouldn’t undergo a major renegotiation but instead be improved and strengthened, according to consultations with key economic sectors overseen by the Mexican government.
title: Mexico Consultations Favor Tweaking USMCA Over Major Revamp

author: Rodrigo Orihuela
description: Spain’s Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has stood out among European leaders in his willingness to go toe-to-toe with US President Donald Trump. His latest stand — barring American forces from using two military bases in Andalusia to carry out strikes on Iran — prompted Trump to threaten to cut off all US trade with Spain.
title: Why Spain’s Sanchez Is Standing Up to Trump on the Iran War

author: Rachel Metz, Jimmy Jenkins
description: Anthropic PBC sued the Defense Department for declaring that the artificial intelligence giant posed a risk to the US supply chain, further ramping up a high-stakes dispute with the Pentagon over safeguards on the company’s technology.
title: Anthropic Sues US Government Over Supply Chain Risk Label

author: Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump said the US would take in the Iranian women’s soccer team if Australia did not provide the players with asylum, amid fears over their safety if they return home.
title: Trump Says US Willing to Take In Iranian Women’s Soccer Team

description: Rising energy prices and uncertainty brought on by tariffs creates "heightened risk around consumer spending and growth," says former Kansas City Fed President Esther George. She speaks on Bloomberg Surveillance. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Energy Shock May Impact Consumer Spending, George Says

author: Omar Tamo
description: Data from the United Arab Emirates suggests Iran’s barrage of missiles and drones has dropped, though it’s unclear why or if the trend will continue.
title: Iran’s Attacks on UAE Ease With Fewest Drones Since War Began

author: William Horobin, Grant Smith, Alessandra Migliaccio
description: Group of Seven finance ministers said they were ready to take any steps needed to support global energy supply, including releasing strategic oil reserves — although the group isn’t at the point of doing so yet.
title: G-7 Ready to Release Oil Stocks If Needed But ‘Not There Yet’

author: William Horobin, Alessandra Migliaccio, Kamil Kowalcze
description: European Union Economy Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis said euro-area finance chiefs will talk about a possible joint release of oil reserves after crude smashed through $100 a barrel.
title: EU’s Dombrovskis Says Release of Oil Reserves Is an Option

author: Myles Miller, Nacha Cattan
description: New York City’s police commissioner said authorities are investigating whether an incident in which two men allegedly brought improvised explosive devices to a protest outside the mayor’s residence in New York was an act of “ISIS-inspired” terrorism.
title: Authorities Probe Alleged ‘ISIS-Inspired’ Attack in New York

description: Ed Morse, Senior Adviser at Hartree Partners, talks about why oil prices are rising faster than gasoline prices. Pump prices are now at their highest level at any time under President Donald Trump. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Why Are Oil Prices Rising Faster Than Gas Prices?

description: NATO intercepted a ballistic missile fired from Iran toward Turkey on Monday, according to a statement by the Defense Ministry, raising the risk that the military alliance could be drawn more directly into the conflict in the Middle East. Patrick Sykes reports from Istanbul.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: NATO Intercepts Ballistic Missile From Iran Heading for Turkey

author: James Hirai, Greg Ritchie
description: Just a month ago, European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde declared that inflation was in a “good place.” With Europe now hurtling toward another energy crisis, traders are struggling to figure out how bad it could get.
title: European Rate Bets Scrambled as Oil Volatility Grips Markets

description: Oil prices soared, with the global Brent benchmark climbing as high as $119.50 a barrel before paring gains. Reports that G-7 finance ministers will hold a call later Monday to discuss a possible joint release of oil reserves helped curb the rally. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Oil Surges As Iran War Fuels Turmoil in Energy Markets

author: Swati Gupta
description: A 35-year-old rapper-turned-politician is on course to become Nepal’s prime minister after his party swept Thursday’s national elections with a commanding majority, according to results released by the country’s Election Commission.
title: Nepal’s Pro-Gen Z Party Leader Set to Become PM in Landslide Win

author: Charlie Duxbury
description: Sweden will amass stockpiles of essentials like fuel, food and power generators in case of crises or war in a further sign of the Nordic state’s increasing concern about conflict spreading to the region.
title: Sweden to Build Fuel, Food Stockpiles as Conflict Worries Grow

author: Arne Delfs, Michael Nienaber
description: Friedrich Merz’s job fixing Germany’s economy just got even harder.
title: Merz’s Economic Plans Hit Another Bump With State Election Loss

author: Niki Koswanage, Tom Redmond
description: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim is poised to drop anti-graft chief Azam Baki after a probe into his shareholdings, people familiar with the matter said.
title: Malaysia’s Anwar Set to Drop Anti-Graft Chief in Wake of Probe

author: Paul Wallace
description: The Islamic Republic has defied the US president by picking a hardliner as the new supreme leader.
title: Iran’s Regime Digs In Against Trump’s Demands

author: Craig Stirling
description: Italy’s push to shake off fiscal scrutiny by the European Union is in danger of being jolted by an extended Middle East crisis, Scope Ratings said.
title: Italy Risks Iran Setback in Bid to Exit EU Scrutiny, Scope Says

author: Pratik Parija
description: Hundreds of farmers and industrial workers gathered in India’s capital on Monday, asking the government to stop what they called concessions to the US in trade talks and to pass a law guaranteeing minimum crop prices.
title: India Farmers Stage Fresh Protest in Delhi Against US Trade Deal

author: Bilal Hussain, Tooba Khan
description: Pakistan’s government plans to implement fuel-saving measures after oil surged above $100 and gas output from the Middle East was disrupted, triggering panic buying in the import-reliant South Asian nation.
title: Pakistan Plans Fuel-Saving Steps After Oil Shock Sparks Panic

author: Jan Bratanic
description: Slovenia’s center-left party of Prime Minister Robert Golob all but closed the gap behind the country’s nationalist opposition, a new poll showed with just two weeks before a tight parliamentary election.
title: Slovenian Opposition Party Narrows Poll Lead Before Election

author: Joe Mayes
description: Nigel Farage invested in the Bitcoin treasury firm Stack BTC Plc run by former Chancellor of the Exchequer Kwasi Kwarteng, the latest push by the poll-topping Reform UK leader in support of cryptoassets.
title: Farage Invests in Kwarteng’s Bitcoin Treasury Firm Stack BTC

author: James Mayger, Yian Lee
description: China warned Japan of consequences after it allowed a rare visit by Taiwan’s No. 3 official, accusing Tokyo of fanning “provocations” as tensions between the top Asian economies continue to simmer.
title: China Warns Japan Over Taiwan Premier’s First Visit Since 1972

author: Ott Ummelas
description: Norway’s police are investigating whether a video posted on a social media site of the US Embassy in Oslo is linked to the weekend’s explosion outside the building.
title: Norway Police Probe If Ayatollah Video Tied to US Embassy Blast

author: Flavia Rotondi, Antonio Vanuzzo
description: Italy’s Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni plans to fast-track a new law decree to tackle the spike in energy prices resulting from the war in the Middle East, Italian media including La Stampa report.
title: Meloni Readies Law to Tackle Energy Price Spikes in Italy

author: Soo-Hyang Choi
description: US military transport planes have flown out of South Korea in recent days, flight-tracking data showed, after Seoul confirmed it was discussing the possible redeployment of American military assets as the Iran conflict escalates.
title: US Planes Fly Out of Korea as Asset Redeployment Reports Grow

description: US President Donald Trump is weighing the option of deploying special forces on the ground in Iran to seize the Islamic Republic's near-bomb-grade uranium, according to three diplomatic officials briefed on the matter. Uncertainty over Iran’s highly enriched uranium has intensified because it’s almost nine months since United Nations atomic inspectors last verified its location, the officials said. Bloomberg Economics Defense Lead Becca Wasser breaks down the situation.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Mulls Using Special Forces to Seize Iran's Uranium

author: Claire Jiao, Swati Pandey
description: Asia’s governments will have to stretch their budgets or risk unleashing an inflation shock as the deepening conflict in the Middle East pushes oil prices past $100 a barrel.
title: $100 Oil Shock Set to Strain Asia’s Cash-Strapped Governments

description:
Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. 

On today's show, oil spiked toward $120 a barrel as more major Middle East producers curbed production, the Strait of Hormuz remained all but closed and the US threatened to deepen a conflict that has upended energy markets.

Mojtaba Khamenei, the son of the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has been named as the new supreme leader of Iran. 

And German Chancellor Friedrich Merz suffered a setback when his conservatives lost a regional election to the Greens, a stinging blow for the unpopular German leader compounded by a jump in support for the far right.

Today's guests: 
Richard Tice, Reform UK Party, Deputy Leader; Laura James, Oxford Analytica, Senior Middle East Analyst. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says Oil 'Small Price To Pay' as Iran Names New Supreme Leader | Daybreak Europe 3/9/2026

description: Angelina Valavina, EMEA corporates, natural resources and commodities head at Fitch Ratings, discusses the impact of the war in Iran on oil markets. Speaking on Bloomberg Television, she says prices will moderate once the transit though the Strait of Hormuz restarts. She also comments on reports that Group of Seven finance ministers are set to discuss a possible joint release of oil reserves on Monday. "It is significant in the sense that it can cool down the oil prices," Valavina says.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Hormuz Closure Likely 'Temporary,' Fitch Ratings Says

author: Swati Gupta
description: India is committed to safeguarding energy security, External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar said, as the world’s third-biggest oil consumer faces supply risks and price shocks after the US threatened to deepen a conflict in Iran that has upended energy markets.
title: India’s Key Priority Is to Secure Energy Needs, Jaishankar Says

description: Oil prices rose to above $100 a barrel as the conflict in the Middle East continues. Brent spiked as much as 29% to $119.50 a barrel. Prices pared gains after the Financial Times reported that Group of Seven finance ministers will discuss a possible joint release of oil from reserves co-ordinated with the International Energy Agency on Monday. Bloomberg’s Stephen Stapczynski breaks down the situation.
title: Oil Pares Gains Amid Report of Reserves Release

author: Paul Wallace, Christine Burke
description: Iran chose Mojtaba Khamenei, the hardline son of the assassinated Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, as its new supreme leader, a choice quickly criticized by US President Donald Trump and one which signals the Islamic Republic won’t back down in a war now raging across the Middle East and causing turmoil in energy markets.
title: Iran Signals No Letup as Khamenei’s Hardline Son Becomes Leader

author: Alberto Nardelli, Donato Paolo Mancini, Stephen Stapczynski, William Horobin
description: The Group of Seven finance ministers are set to discuss a possible joint release of oil reserves on Monday, according to people familiar with the matter, as the Middle East war chokes flows from the region and sends prices soaring.
title: G-7 to Discuss Joint Release of Emergency Oil Reserves

author: Patpicha Tanakasempipat
description: Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul, whose party won last month’s election, has finalized his new coalition to form a government that will steer the nation’s $577 billion economy after decades of economic stagnation.
title: Thai PM Seals New Coalition After Feb. Election, Local Media Say

description: Iran named Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the late Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, as its new supreme leader. This comes amid escalating war and a surge in oil prices. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Khamenei’s Son Takes Power as Oil Surges Past $100

author: Beril Akman, Firat Kozok
description: Istanbul Mayor Ekrem Imamoglu, the Turkish opposition politician whose arrest last year caused market turmoil, will go on trial Monday on corruption charges that could result in a combined sentence of more than 2,000 years.
title: Top Erdogan Rival Goes on Trial, Faces Two-Millenia Jail Term

author: Soo-Hyang Choi
description: The US and South Korea reduced the scale of annual springtime joint military drills long denounced by North Korea, as Seoul attempts to ease tensions with Pyongyang ahead of President Donald Trump’s planned visit to the region.
title: US, South Korea Hold Reduced Drills as China Prepares Trump Trip
